versions.changelog:
Initial release — automates TikTok slideshow marketing and analytics feedback loop for apps and products.

- Automates competitor research, AI image generation, text overlays, slideshow posting to TikTok (via PosteAhora), and analytics tracking.
- Provides a daily feedback loop with analytics from PosteAhora and optional conversion tracking via RevenueCat.
- Supports cross-posting to Instagram, YouTube, Threads, and more.
- Guides users through TikTok account warmup and onboarding conversationally, not as a checklist.
- Fully configurable image generation (OpenAI, Stability AI, Replicate, or local images).
- Enables hook testing, CTA optimization, and continuous improvement based on real performance data.
